title: Writing 写作
paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题风格卷（原创题面）
prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on whether College Chinese should be a compulsory course for all university students. In your essay you should: 1) state clearly whether you think the course should be compulsory; 2) give reasons to support your view; 3) draw a conclusion. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference:
Some universities have made College Chinese a compulsory course, and the decision has caused much discussion. In my opinion, the course should be required, though it should be taught in a way that suits students of different majors.

First, language ability is the foundation of almost every subject. Students who cannot write a clear report or explain an idea in good Chinese will struggle in their future jobs, however strong their professional skills are. Second, the course is not only about grammar. Reading classical and modern texts helps young people understand their own culture and think about values, which is especially valuable in a fast-changing world. Third, a shared course brings students from different departments together and gives them something to discuss.

For these reasons, I believe College Chinese deserves to be compulsory. Universities should give it real credit and use lively teaching methods instead of old-fashioned recitation, so that students take it seriously.
